checks.name: Two visit options use the same component, with explicit modalities
Horizontal service rail scrolls with the keyboard
Focusing the last service brings it into view
Visit details expose missing location honestly, without a fictional map
Location sheet closes with Escape and restores trigger focus
In-clinic entry opens the existing public booking flow with the correct mode
Online entry opens available test times, not a programme purchase or fake call
First-visit questions work with native keyboard disclosure
Ongoing care leads directly to the saved programme library
Visits stack on mobile and pair on desktop without horizontal page overflow
